reader.requirement: At 85 a READ of a relative file in random access mode, or of a dynamic-access relative file read without NEXT, is a Format 2 read (random retrieval by the RELATIVE KEY, INVALID KEY/NOT INVALID KEY, no NEXT, AT END or NOT AT END), and the compiler must refuse a Format 1 phrase on a random-access file and bind the dynamic no-NEXT READ as a random retrieval.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Year < 2002: a dynamic READ writing AT END without NEXT is refused (COBOL7144, 1985 SR3) instead of being the 2002+ SR9-implied NEXT; the bound ReadKind is the same either way
severity seam only (strict error, permissive warning); not keyed on the edition

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a dynamic READ with AT END and no NEXT is refused (SR3), where 2002+ implies NEXT; PREVIOUS and the lock phrases are refused at 85. The random-mode refusal and the dynamic no-NEXT random binding are the same code at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f21_03 covers random and dynamic Format 2 reads with fixed records; g85_f21_09 covers NEXT+AT END on a random file. Not exercised: AT END alone or NOT AT END on a random file, INVALID KEY on a NEXT read of a dynamic file, variable-length records, INTO on a random read, key 0 / out of range.

reader.notes: KeyedIoBinder.BindRead binds RANDOM as ReadKind.Random and DYNAMIC without NEXT/AT END as Random; CheckReadRandomAccessPhrases refuses Format 1 phrases on a random file and the grammar's phrase association refuses INVALID KEY beside NEXT. At 85 the dynamic AT-END-without-NEXT form gets its own refusal (CheckReadDynamicNextWritten). Probe r1prev's diagnostic names the INVALID KEY association rather than the 2002 introduction of PREVIOUS, but the program is refused.
